address: 47 Main Street, Barton-under-Needwood, DE13 8AA, United Kingdom

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Coming from the same owner as The Boat in nearby Lichfield, this delightful spot offers all you could want in a country pub. The lovely village setting is mirrored in the cosy, welcoming interior with a snug bar, slightly more formal dining room and a terrace for the summer. The menu sticks to the classics and delivers them with bags of joyous flavour, from a Welsh rarebit snack to smoked haddock fishcake, pork schnitzel and a knockout trifle for dessert. Steaks from the grill or roasted fish to share are ideal for a special occasion.
